agents.name: Claude Code
agents.description: Anthropic's coding agent, run on your Claude membership or API key. Writes and edits files in a story's workspace.

agents.name: Codex
agents.description: OpenAI's coding agent, run on your ChatGPT membership or API key. Writes and edits files in a story's workspace.

agents.name: Grok
agents.description: xAI's coding agent. Writes and edits files in a story's workspace.

agents.name: OpenClaw
agents.description: Open agent runtime for any OpenRouter model; used for cheaper read-only and review stories.

agents.name: Hermes
agents.description: The coordinator: plans and follows a project, never writes code itself.

system_tools.name: Python 3
system_tools.description: Runs Python scripts and tests in a story's workspace.

system_tools.name: Node.js
system_tools.description: Runs JavaScript builds and tests; installed with the agent tools.

system_tools.name: FFmpeg
system_tools.description: Converts and trims audio and video for media stories.

system_tools.name: Docker CLI
system_tools.description: Builds and runs containers; a host step, never inside an agent story.

system_tools.name: Colima
system_tools.description: The local container engine Docker uses on a Mac.

system_tools.name: GitHub CLI
system_tools.description: The dashboard's own repository and pull request steps; stories never call it.

system_tools.name: Gitleaks
system_tools.description: Scans a workspace for committed secrets.

system_tools.name: Playwright
system_tools.description: Drives a browser for screenshots and page checks.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.description: API access to many models, billed per use with your own key.

providers.name: fal
providers.description: Image and video generation in Media studio, billed per use with your own key after you approve the spend.

checks.name: Course package check
checks.description: Checks a course folder against upubhub's import and class-setup limits before the verification story is accepted.

services.name: upubhub.com
services.description: Publishing and classroom site. Packs prepare files for it; the user uploads them, or pushes them with the upubhub-push connector after signing off.

connectors.name: Push to upubhub
connectors.description: After your final sign-off, the dashboard pushes a course, textbook or lesson plan to upubhub.com as private drafts with your saved upubhub token. Agents never hold the token.
